## F-INVARIANT AND E-INVARIANT

## PEIGEN CAO

ABSTRACT . F-invariant for of elements (e.g. cluster monomials) in cluster algebras is introduced by the author in a previous work. feature of F-invariant is that it is coordinate free invariant, that is, it is mutation invariant under the initial seed mutations E-invariant for of decorated representations of quivers with potentials is introduced by Derksen; Weyman and Zelevinsky; which is also a coordinate-free invariant The strategies used to show the mutationinvariance of F-invariant and E-invariant are totally different \_ good pair key pair

In this paper, we give a new proof of the mutation-invariance of F-invariant following the strategy used by Derksen;  Weyman and Zelevinsky. As a result, E-invariant on cluster   monomials We also give proof of Reading 's conjecture; which says that the non-compatible cluster   variables in cluster  algebras can be separated by the sign-coherence of g-vectors

Cluster algebras.   Cluster algebras were introduced by Fomin and Zelevinsky [FZO2] as a combinatorial approach to the upper global bases of quantum groups and to the theory of total positivity in algebraic groups.
